instruction: Candid documentary medium full shot of a sandy beach under an overcast sky. On the left, the older man in the red athletic shirt (R3) jogs forward, looking back over his shoulder. In the center, the woman in the grey jacket and black visor (R2) jogs with arms outstretched. On the right, the older man in the dark camo shirt (R1) jogs behind her with his hands on her shoulders. The lighting is diffuse with cool tones.
